cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you to judge a proposal. For the workshop move, are you backing mine or Morgan's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've learned to compare. Now finish the exercise: whose side will you say you're on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll say I support the compromise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still leaving the hard answer blank. When Morgan and I both claim your support, which of us will you correct? Say it to your teacher now; the meeting will be harder.

reason: Use the claimed pupil relationship to shape the precise authority pursuit, keeping each partner response an actual cause of the next tactic.
